title: Repository Initializer - public implementations survey

description:
Good Repository Initializer practice is not talent - it is failure-mode drill. It turns Repository Initializer from an event into a repeatable capability.

Concretely: verify outputs against the original request, not against your hopes; keep a failure log: what broke, why, and what now prevents it; review the result with fresh eyes before calling it done This record exists because the difference between a tool and a capability is discipline. Run the demo, adopt the checklist, and Repository Initializer becomes something your builds can rely on.
